contact_control_cube.scope: One row per distinct actual collision (trajectory, control, arc); multiple arcs in one control remain separate incidences, not independent controls

definitions.E: Per-letter union of proven reachable bins across its nine actual legal initial poses (54 total poses)
definitions.H: Distinct bins hit by actual new-stage collision points; repeated touches do not enlarge this set
definitions.K: R union E union H; demonstrated reachability lower bound across canonical, initial and observed poses, not all physically reachable bins
definitions.R: Canonical zero-angle normal-path geometry proof from existing canonical report
definitions.control_incidence: Sum of per-bin contacted controls may exceed distinct object-contact controls when multiple bins touched in one control
definitions.features: Existing feature labels overlap; corner_or_concavity is not separately disambiguated
definitions.planned_target: Preselected object contour arc, not pusher absolute click-target arrival
definitions.unconfirmed: All bins minus K minus proven closed-hole bins; not declared impossible

historical_priority.role: Selection priority only; historical counts excluded from H/E, independent stage1 trajectories, contact controls and points

scope: Only the 54 completed stage1 trajectories; no historical hit or control counters mixed in
